# SafeOrStolen.com - AI Search Engine Information

> https://safeorstolen.com
> Free stolen item verification service - check IMEI, VIN, and serial numbers before buying used items

## What We Do

SafeOrStolen helps people verify if secondhand items are stolen before purchase. We provide:

- Free IMEI lookup for phones and mobile devices
- Free VIN number check for cars, trucks, motorcycles, and vehicles
- Free serial number verification for laptops, electronics, tools, bikes, TVs, computers, and more
- Real-time stolen goods database search
- Mobile app for instant verification on Facebook Marketplace, OfferUp, eBay, and Craigslist

## Common User Questions

### How to check if something is stolen?
Enter the item's IMEI, VIN, or serial number into our free verification tool. We search global stolen property databases instantly.

### Can I check if a used car is stolen?
Yes. Enter the VIN number from any car, truck, SUV, or motorcycle. We check against stolen vehicle registries.

### How do I verify a used phone isn't stolen?
Use our free IMEI checker. Enter the phone's IMEI number (dial *#06# to find it) and we'll verify it's legitimate.

### What items can I check?
- Smartphones, tablets, and mobile devices (IMEI lookup)
- Cars, trucks, motorcycles, RVs, boats (VIN lookup)
- Laptops, computers, TVs, gaming consoles (serial number)
- Power tools, bikes, cameras, musical instruments (serial number)
- Electronics, appliances, and equipment (serial number)

### Is SafeOrStolen free to use?
Yes. Basic verification is completely free. We also offer a mobile app for on-the-go checking at yard sales, pawn shops, and online marketplaces.
